Requested treatments: brief resolving-text reveal, coordinated motion, frosted glass, organised landing composition, and a substantial raffle-detail refresh. Keep the established artwork and lavender/chrome/lime palette.

Atelier and Sora public pages were read in this session. Atelier describes hand-timed animation and gallery/text treatments; Sora lists text reveals, gallery/scroll and tilt transitions. Originkit and Cue are client-rendered; Pixel Perfect could not be fetched by the web tool. A T3 visual snapshot of Atelier failed twice. Do not claim its visuals were inspected in this session.
